notes.manas-2010:p1395:b001:l001: Sword concealed beneath clothes continues preceding1394:42 double-edged stone-cutter; no weapon modifier omitted from this source fragment.
notes.manas-2010:p1395:b001:l006: Эки-Кемин Two Kemins, geographic dual retained rather than one modern district identification.
notes.manas-2010:p1395:b001:l009: Dark forest made into wealth, harrier trained into hunting hawk, scattered people/sand united into a people/stone1395:10–15 retained as parallel foundation metaphors.
notes.manas-2010:p1395:b001:l016: Eybit Khan’s son Ürbü, following established epic patronymic construction. Printed Эйбит retained, not harmonized to another variant.
notes.manas-2010:p1396:b001:l007: Printed envoys seeing it retained; possible intended reverse viewpoint from princes on tower, no silent subject swap.
notes.manas-2010:p1396:b001:l008: Калча Kongurbay’s grim-faced epithet, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/калча/ I1–2. Repeated1396:27/1397:40, not mountain-Tajik ethnic label.
notes.manas-2010:p1396:b001:l020: Аса байлап attached to bronze idol, provisionally hang/fasten high. Not blindly substituting horse-head-high sense of аса байла in unrelated horse context; exact ritual mounting arrangement unverified.
notes.manas-2010:p1396:b001:l032: Алма affectionate/short form of Almambet, retained as Alma; blazing dog insult preserved, not an actual burning dog.
notes.manas-2010:p1396:b001:l035: чантуу Chinese/Kalmyk epic exonym for Muslims, Yudakhin/2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/чантуу/, literally turban-wearers. English retains both gloss and referent.
notes.manas-2010:p1396:b001:l041: түмөн epic multitude unit, vast host of monks; no invented ten-thousand census.
notes.manas-2010:p1397:b001:l009: уялуу журт established/rooted or mighty numerous people, Yudakhin/1969 https://el-sozduk.kg/уялуу/. Repeated1407:34,1408:42,1413:2 with contextual established/mighty gloss.
notes.manas-2010:p1397:b001:l026: Printed турун provisionally while staying/remain, context explicit abandoning Outer Beijing for Inner Beijing; no raw change.
notes.manas-2010:p1397:b001:l037: талак кыл renounce/abandon, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/талак/ sense2, not literal divorce from a city.
notes.manas-2010:p1398:b001:l007: зыйкыр variant сыйкыр sorcery, https://el-sozduk.kg/зыйкыр/. Sorcerer/dragon/marksman/boar/tiger defenses all retained as epic enchantment, no rationalization into machinery.
notes.manas-2010:p1398:b001:l022: асый counts livestock age from its fifth year: one = fifth year, two = sixth, etc., Yudakhin/1969 https://el-sozduk.kg/асый/. Printed sixty preserved with explicit maturity-count wording; not ordinary sixty years or a silently replaced modern-age number.
notes.manas-2010:p1398:b001:l033: жалаңкыч angel that takes human life, 1969 https://el-sozduk.kg/жалаңкыч/. Source explicitly names Жебирейил Gabriel, retained despite conventional death-angel identification differing; no substitution of Azrael.
notes.manas-2010:p1398:b001:l034: Printed five hands retained; possibly metonymic five fingers, but no unmarked anatomical normalization.
notes.manas-2010:p1398:b001:l035: Printed Менде provisionally пенде mortal/servant, repeated1398:37 and clear death/endurance maxim; contextual lexical reading, raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p1399:b001:l004: We died on departure is envoy’s declaration of readiness for death, not actual death report. All repetitions1399:10–11 retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1399:b001:l015: жаздык ала жат kill enemy together with oneself when facing death, 1969/Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/жаздык/. Pillow image retained with enemy explicitly identified, repeated1402:8.
notes.manas-2010:p1399:b001:l026: Printed тил тилген contextually knew languages; likely defective тил билген, supported repeated seventy-burku-language formula1309:25. Raw retained, no transcription repair claimed.
notes.manas-2010:p1399:b001:l037: дилде gold or gold coin, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/дилде/. Here gold material throne, not unverified coins fastened to throne; алтын/дилде paired lists elsewhere retain gold/gold-coins distinction.
notes.manas-2010:p1400:b001:l014: жин guts/stomach contents in battle formula, not spirits. Water/poison, cap/head, blood/guts parallel preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p1400:b001:l019: Negative spear formula provisionally never drew back extended spear, consistent unflinching fighters; exact сунуп...тартпаган idiomatic scope qualified, no silent positive thrust substitution.
notes.manas-2010:p1400:b001:l031: аты уйкаш names rhyme/match per Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/уйкаш/, retained despite Almambet/Chubak not literally rhyming. No renaming to manufacture rhyme.
notes.manas-2010:p1400:b001:l034: Printed What shall I do? retained despite unusual placement in demand; no invented surrender ultimatum replacing question.
notes.manas-2010:p1401:b001:l004: Sons of brothers gives Bakay/Manas cousin relationship; retains genealogy rather than treating them as brothers.
notes.manas-2010:p1401:b001:l023: Father’s spirit made renowned/released through memorial feast, qualified чыгарган; no added detailed rite.
notes.manas-2010:p1401:b001:l027: эригерлик not one to idle/be bored, provisionally active warrior; no invented unrelated threat.
notes.manas-2010:p1401:b001:l039: кызыталак coarse curse, Yudakhin redirects to талак: literally daughter divorced, figuratively scoundrel, https://el-sozduk.kg/кызыталак/ and https://el-sozduk.kg/талак/. Literal daughter-divorce curse retained in intelligible English, no sexual act invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1402:b001:l011: Printed Ezkara’s presence/position retained, despite Ezkara also counted among captured lords later; no replacement with Manas.
notes.manas-2010:p1402:b001:l019: карандай completely/to the utmost, Yudakhin sense2 https://el-sozduk.kg/карандай/. Speech-sharpening metaphor retained, no coinage from literal dark.
notes.manas-2010:p1402:b001:l028: Eighteen thousand worlds retained as epic cosmological number, not modern astronomical assertion.
notes.manas-2010:p1403:b001:l010: мыйзамдын гүлү autumn gossamer, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/мыйзам/ sense6; not flowers of law. Six months1403:11 retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1403:b001:l015: сурак кыл govern/rule, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/сурак/ sense2. Repeated1410:32,1414:29/35, not interrogation.
notes.manas-2010:p1403:b001:l038: келеме бото netted outer garment, exact edition1839:4. Separate from келеме жака metallic-braid collar and келеме шарып Quran.
notes.manas-2010:p1404:b001:l030: жатмак resolved to remain/lie low, provisionally submit in surrounding acceptance/tribute demands1404:31–37; exact nuance qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1404:b001:l032: Thousand girls with daughter retained; later1408:24 thousand including two leaders differs in counting scope, no reconciliation.
notes.manas-2010:p1404:b001:l041: кароол кан guard khan literal compound, repeated1408:17; no precise historical office asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1405:b001:l001: агача fair-faced young wife, exact Yudakhin formula https://el-sozduk.kg/агача/. Tribute women and coercion retained, no invented consent.
notes.manas-2010:p1405:b001:l011: желбеген жорго smooth amblers, likely non-jolting gait; negative participle retained contextually, no impossible wind-free horse explanation.
notes.manas-2010:p1405:b001:l019: Handgrip waist, rooster neck, snow flesh/blood cheeks and moon face are epic beauty images, all retained without modern body proportions.
notes.manas-2010:p1405:b001:l026: келеңкер чачпак braid ornament of strings with pendants/trinkets, exact Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/келеңкер/. English pendant-strung braids, no opaque kelengker transliteration; reed-like waist keeps найча comparison.
notes.manas-2010:p1405:b001:l028: Printed Айжаң shortened form of Ay Jangjung retained as Ayzhang, not different inferred father.
notes.manas-2010:p1405:b001:l035: бил I elephant, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/бил/; билге dative loading onto elephants, not unverified bilge object. Confirmed exact elephant-back transport1408:29.
notes.manas-2010:p1406:b001:l013: Few souls surpass her is qualified construal of printed артыкча жандан аз; аз few retained semantically, possible defective уз not silently substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p1406:b001:l017: Printed кан khan retained in description of Birmyskal, though could refer parent Ay Jangjung or be defective жан; no silent common-person substitution. Attribution remains provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p1406:b001:l026: ике кыялы wedding rite, printed variant of нике кыюу; clear paired marriage context, repeated1409:11/17. No opaque ike transliteration.
notes.manas-2010:p1406:b001:l042: чыбык кыюу twig-cutting oath, exact2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/чыбык%20кыюу/. White wheat flour chewing and handclasp preceding retained; no Quran oath inserted where not printed.
notes.manas-2010:p1407:b001:l010: Printed rejoicing of Beijing retained despite coerced surrender around it; no emotional harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p1407:b001:l025: канча provisionally duration as long as desired in surrender of khanship; exact elliptical wording qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1408:b001:l005: Forty-year prophecy retained;1414:30 later says six years, no harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p1408:b001:l026: көөр gemstone/precious stone, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/көөр/. No exact mineral species invented beyond жакут ruby.
notes.manas-2010:p1408:b001:l041: үптө manage/put in order, exact unmanageable-booty formula Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/үптө/. Captured women context preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p1409:b001:l015: айдар male forelock/tuft/braid, Yudakhin/1969 https://el-sozduk.kg/айдар/; golden forelock, not invented helmet crest. чок белбоо tasseled belt, repeated1409:24.
notes.manas-2010:p1409:b001:l022: жарым кан half-khan literal rank description, no precise office invented. Tash-Köpürö city proper name retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1409:b001:l026: Printed Torgut called Chinese retained as epic classification, not asserted modern ethnic equivalence.
notes.manas-2010:p1409:b001:l028: сөгүлтүп dividing/unraveling forces provisionally distribution across territories; troop-versus-commanders grammar1409:30–31 uncertain, no invented individual appointments.
notes.manas-2010:p1409:b001:l029: Parenthesized narrator verse retained in full as verse, not discarded editorial heading.
notes.manas-2010:p1409:b001:l037: Printed edge not budging retained in indestructible-carpet hyperbole, despite unusual койбогон form; no raw emendation.
notes.manas-2010:p1410:b001:l023: түтүн household, one horse from each, explicit levy retained;1411:1 two households per cauldron also exact.
notes.manas-2010:p1410:b001:l030: Blue as iron retains printed color/strength metaphor; no unsupported new armor issue claimed.
notes.manas-2010:p1410:b001:l031: Solomon/Sulayman and Alexander/Iskender conventional English proper names. Epic conquest claims retained, no historical verification implied.
notes.manas-2010:p1411:b001:l009: True Muslim declaration immediately contradicted by narrator’s false conversion1411:15–16; both retained. Sword/axe violence1411:11–12 possibly coercive circumcision, but no unprinted procedure specified.
notes.manas-2010:p1411:b001:l018: ашмачы cook, Yudakhin/1969 https://el-sozduk.kg/ашмачы/. Espionage through food service narrated by following learning/writing lines.
notes.manas-2010:p1412:b001:l009: Though a woman retained as source gendered rhetoric; Kanyshay’s khanship and military support explicit.
notes.manas-2010:p1412:b001:l014: Literal remaining where they had not died retained; unclear relation to named casualties next lines, not silently negation-removed.
notes.manas-2010:p1412:b001:l027: шай protective unseen patron, English gloss in epic formula; no unsupported modern religious identity assigned.
notes.manas-2010:p1412:b001:l034: сызык чий decide to act, particularly hostile action, exact Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/сызык/. Resolved to strike, not arbitrary geometric line; implicit subject provisionally Manas.
notes.manas-2010:p1412:b001:l042: умачтай eyes fully awake/clear, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/умач/; here waking sleep metaphor, not flour-gruel noun.
notes.manas-2010:p1413:b001:l024: Printed Манас repeated on1413:24/25; provisionally companions become like Manas, each a Khan Manas. Unusual dative/subject grammar not silently repaired or repetition omitted.
notes.manas-2010:p1413:b001:l029: укурук кайрар champion able to resist/protect against an enemy, exact Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/укурук/. English resistance gloss replaces literal catching-pole misreading.
notes.manas-2010:p1413:b001:l039: чыңоолуу forged/hardened, https://el-sozduk.kg/чыңоо/. Red iron image retained, no modern metallurgical specification.
notes.manas-2010:p1414:b001:l003: Tears across ten fields retains exact number/image, not reduced to many tears.
notes.manas-2010:p1414:b001:l030: Six years before recorded prophecy and six-month rule1414:29/37 retained, alongside earlier forty-year prophecy1408:5. No chronological reconciliation.
